note: Gooding County (Ordinance 104) publishes its official zoning map and area zoning maps (Gooding, Wendell/Bliss, Hagerman, Clear Lakes) only as PDF/image maps. No ArcGIS REST, WFS or bulk zoning-district layer found for the county or its cities (Gooding, Wendell, Bliss, Hagerman). Wendell's official zoning map is kept on file at the city clerk. The IDWR statewide parcel layer and the county Gooding_County_Mask_ service carry no zoning field. Third-party Regrid/Zoneomics data is not official and was not used.
